goal: Apply owner ruling 2026-10-21 (Albert Hazan, "make it 1hr."): the protected-source stale-place inactivity window in scripts/check-pr-source-collisions.mjs drops from 24 hours to one hour; legacy inactive-24h nudges still parse; ruling recorded as docs/owner-rulings.md §6.29. No other condition or fail-closed signal changes.
worker: Same session; one constant, its comments, two tests and the ruling entry.
prohibited_actions: No change to lastActivityAt; the cross-reference fix is a separate sub-session's pull request.
No removal of the nudge, failing-check or conflict conditions, and no change to fail-closed handling of unreadable signals.
No schema, data, setting or branch-protection change.
assumptions: The implementation head e45d9f9130b95bc2835a5c1834bd3c35b8223a4a was authored before this contract was published; disclosed, and every later commit follows it.
Issue #3273, which introduced the rule, is closed; this lands under #3779 because the window directly governs how long a release hold on a protected source can stall.
stop_conditions: Stop before any production, preview, database or repository-setting action.
